tasks.description: Correct only README availability language for the shipped PyPI 0.3.0 offline rss-review and rss-compare commands. Remove source-checkout-only assertions for the five RSS review/compare sections, add pinned uvx --from mcp-trendpulse==0.3.0 commands for both installed-package help flows, preserve existing evidence/demand limitations and unrelated source-only labels. A sealed independent PyPI 0.3.0 smoke preflight already verified both command help flows. Do not publish packages or edit source code.

Implement opt-in rss-compare --contains TEXT for saved-RSS offline snapshot comparison using case-insensitive literal title matching (trim printable 1-120 characters) and union of URLs matching either older or newer title before exact-URL status classification. Preserve capture-wide quality alerts for excluded titles, classify retained URLs correctly when retitled outside the filter, expose filter method/matched counts/scope in JSON/Markdown/CSV, require review on zero matches, preserve default output byte-for-byte with no flag. Add real offline tests, no provider calls.
